headlineHtml: One manifest. From a €5 VPS to production. Open source.
subhead: AppRafter is an opinionated PaaS on Kubernetes. Describe your applications in a single CUE manifest — the same one runs from a single VDS to a multi-node production cluster. Open source (FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0). A managed version is coming for those who'd rather not run ops themselves.
statusBadge: v0.3 · Phase 3 · MVP shipped on Tier 1 and Tier 2 · managed in development
